description: The line plot illustrates the training loss over the course of training for six different models—ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBART Medium 20M, ChemBERTa Small 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, ChemLLaMA Small 20M, and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M—on a dataset of 20 million data points. The x-axis, labeled "Step," represents the number of training steps, ranging from 0K to 440K, with major tick marks at intervals of 20K. The y-axis, labeled "Train Loss," measures the loss value on a scale from 0.0 to 0.85. All six models exhibit a similar trend: a rapid decrease in training loss in the initial steps, followed by a slower convergence to a stable, low-loss value. The ChemBART Small 20M (red line) and ChemBART Medium 20M (blue line) models start with the highest loss, around 0.8, and converge to a loss of approximately 0.15. The ChemBERTa Small 20M (green line) and ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange line) models start slightly lower, around 0.75, and converge to a loss of about 0.12. The ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple line) and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown line) models start at a loss of approximately 0.7 and converge to a loss of about 0.1. The ChemLLaMA models show a slightly lower final loss compared to the ChemBART and ChemBERTa models, and the Medium versions of all models appear to converge to a slightly lower loss than their Small counterparts.
